$comment: Canonical opt-in Cool/Warm neutral and Acid/Violet accent roles. Legacy tokens.json and its defaults remain unchanged. This source owns promoted values; direction-demo palettes are historical review evidence only.

meta.name: approved-foundations
meta.provenance: Operator-approved 2026-09-29: linear-marathon / cursor-marathon neutral planes, Acid roles and electric Violet roles from direction-demos/palettes.css. Explicit action states are derived here and validated with their ink. Typography and radius remain the common legacy scales; theme never changes component geometry.
meta.contract: Theme and accent are independent from appearance. Missing data-theme means System; explicit data-theme=dark|light wins. Opt-in requires data-pxo-theme=cool|warm. Missing or invalid accent uses Acid. Invalid theme does not opt in. Consumers own DOM, OS observation and persistence. Existing consumers retain saved appearance; do not silently adopt the new default.
